Three analyses explicitly reconstruct Higgs-boson candidates as physical objects: 2004.04545 (ATLAS $CP$ properties study), 2504.13081 (differential Higgs cross-sections), and 2510.07527 (nonresonant Higgs pair production). These define Higgs candidates via diphoton systems, b-tagged jets, or multi-object final states.

question: Which analyses require exactly two electrons OR exactly two muons as alternative selections -- parallel ee and mumu channels, rather than requiring both?

answer.text:
Analyses requiring exactly two electrons OR two muons as parallel channels include those in set_1 and set_2. Key examples are: ATLAS-2018-015 (W/Z boson measurements), ATLAS-2018-003 (Higgs four-lepton final states), ATLAS-_2017-053 (top quark studies), and ATLAS-2017-025 (W/Z cross-sections). These papers explicitly use both ee and mumu channels independently.

Papers: 2009.14537, 2011.07812, 2012.08600, 2208.12095, 2402.08486
